The hidden cost of high performance

You can be driven, successful, and still feel like something is off.

You may be responsible for a career, a company, or a life that looks exactly right from the outside. But high performance can hide private strain.

The cost often shows up quietly. Sleep changes. Focus slips. Patience gets shorter. Success starts to bring less relief.

Burnout and Anxiety

For professionals still showing up and performing, but running on empty underneath and unable to fully recover.

Relationship Pressure

For ambitious adults where stress or emotional distance has started to widen the gap between them and the people they care about.

Identity and Direction

For high-achievers asking bigger questions about who they are, what they actually want, and what comes next.

For High Achievers and Professionals

When Ambition and Life Start Pulling in Different Directions.

High achievers often carry a lot quietly. The work is demanding, relationships need attention, and there is never quite enough space to figure out what is actually happening inside. Dr. Goodin works with individuals to create that space.

Communication and Connection

When conversations feel tense, avoidant, or just stop happening.

Emotional Distance

When you are busy and successful and somehow still feel far from the people around you.

Ambition and Personal Life

When career pressure and the rest of life start competing for the same energy.

Anxiety and Overthinking

When a sharp, fast mind becomes the thing making it hardest to slow down.

Why Dr. Goodin

Senior Clinical Care.
Not Generic Advice.

Dr. Tina Goodin brings decades of clinical experience to individuals and professionals. Her background includes doctoral-level psychology, board certification, psychoanalytic training, hospital affiliation, and deep experience with complex emotional and relational concerns.

Some things do not need advice. They need a private room, an experienced mind, and enough time to understand what is really happening.

PhD Clinical Psychologist

Doctoral-level psychological training from McGill University and senior clinical judgment across 24 years of practice.

ABPP Diplomate

Advanced professional distinction held by fewer than 5% of licensed psychologists. A mark of expertise and peer-reviewed excellence.

Board Certified Psychoanalyst

Specialized depth training for complex emotional and relational patterns that shorter approaches do not reach.

Fellow, IPA

Fellowship in the International Psychoanalytical Association. International professional standing and recognized clinical depth.

Good Samaritan Medical Center

Hospital affiliation in Palm Beach, Florida, adding medical community credibility and professional accountability.

Highly individualized work
